next.reason: X3.23a-1989 (its change for page X-6, a typographical correction, errata C146) only boxed the exception as level 2; the words are the printed ones. §1985:X.1.3.8.1 SR3: a separately compiled program's name 'may be referenced by statements included in any other program in the run unit, except programs it directly or indirectly contains'. §2023:8.4.6.3 SR3: 'If the program-name is that of an outermost program, that program-name may be referenced by statements included in any source element in the run unit.' Same subject (who may reference an outermost program's name in CALL and CANCEL), different requirement: 2023 drops the words 'any other program' and 'except programs it directly or indirectly contains', so the program itself and the programs it contains may now reference its name, which 1985 refuses; the level-2 box is no difference. What 2023 does with such a call of an active program is a run-time matter outside this rule (§2023:14.9.4.4 GR3f: EC-PROGRAM-RECURSIVE-CALL unless the program has the recursive attribute).
